journey.name: Settings
journey.description: Open Settings from every tab, export and import, see the plan's goal and reminder, change a cue and the theme, then put the theme back. Run on a phone in portrait, where Settings opens full screen.

actions.action: Tap the "Settings" button in Today's title bar and verify that Settings opens; tap "Back" and verify that the Today tab is shown
Tap the "Train" tab, which opens on "Strength", then the "Settings" button in its title bar, and verify that Settings opens; tap "Back" and verify that Train's Strength pillar is shown
Tap the "History" tab, then the "Settings" button in its title bar, and verify that Settings opens; tap "Back" and verify that the History tab is shown
Tap the "Timer" tab, then its "Settings" button
Verify, scrolling down, that the Settings screen shows "Cues", "Workout", "Calories", "Health", "Plan", "Appearance" and "Your data", and "About Interval" at its foot with no heading over it
Under "Plan", verify that "Weekly goal" and "Reminder" each read "Off" (a fresh install), then tap "Weekly goal" and verify that the Plan page opens
Tap "Raise the goal", tap "Reminder", pick "6:00 PM" and tap "Done"; tap "Back" and verify that Settings reads "3" beside "Weekly goal" and "6:00 PM" beside "Reminder"
Tap "Export" under "Your data"
Verify that the system share sheet opens with a file named like "interval-2026-10-27.json" (today's date)
Dismiss the share sheet with Back
Before the next step, put an export from another phone in Downloads: adb push an `interval-*.json` (the schema-1 file in `apps/app/test/fixtures/ExportFixtures.kt` will do) to /sdcard/Download/
Tap "Import" under "Your data" and verify that the system's file picker opens
Tap the export in Downloads (or Recent) and verify that a sheet says "Exported on" its date, lists what is "New:" and offers "Also settings" off and "Import"
Tap "Import" in the sheet and verify that a notice says "Imported" with the same counts
Tap "Import" under "Your data" again, pick the same file, and verify that the sheet says "Everything in it is already here."; tap "Cancel"
Scroll up to "Cues" and tap the "Voice" switch
Verify that the "Voice" switch is off
Scroll to "Appearance" and verify that "Dark" is selected under "Theme", the theme a fresh install starts on
Tap "Light" under "Theme"
Verify that "Light" is selected and the screen has a light background
Go back with the system's Back
Verify that the Timer tab is shown with a light background
Tap the "Settings" button on the Timer tab
Verify that the "Voice" switch is still off
Tap "Voice", scroll to "Appearance" and tap "Dark" under "Theme"
Go back with the system's Back
Verify that the Timer tab is shown
